# Governance

Stores decision records, ownership, dependencies, approval paths and change control for the RAIMOV ecosystem.

Authoritative strategy decisions still belong in `docs/ssot/EXPERT_DENTAL_RAIMOV_ELITE_STRATEGY.md`. This directory stores implementation governance: who owns a decision, what it blocks, when it was approved and what downstream files must change.

Do not store patient data, evidence files, public copy or unsigned legal claims here.
